note: Paper-trading research only. Forecasts are EMOS-calibrated multi-model NWP Gaussians per settlement station; once a settlement day is under way its predicted_high_f also carries the observed high-so-far update the trading path serves, with the pre-update mean kept as predicted_high_f_pre_intraday. Every market settles on its own NWS Climatological Report. Each book is one economically separate paper account and books are never summed: books.live is only the active Live Stability account and books.research only the active research account (book_accounts names both), while each archived ledger (legacy live, earlier research versions, motion and the old research shadow) keeps its own book under books.archived. open_positions counts filled contracts and resting_orders counts unfilled limit orders, matching the Strategy Lab.
